summary: Gorax pulls extensively on the Dragon Crown Homage coffer event targeting the Dark Lady Limited Figurine. He purchases the discounted vouchers using paid currency/Dragon Crystals and pulls across multiple coffres, monitoring available pool counts. During the session, he secures the Dark Lady Limited Figurine, multiple Legendary Hero Prime Chests containing support heroes, and a large surplus of Heliolite Dice. He highlights that spenders can effectively profit on Heliolite Dice while simultaneously triggering the Starlit Delights event rebates.
tips: In the Dragon Crown Homage event, monitor the remaining rewards per coffer; avoid pulling in pools where the main S-tier figurine or coveted rewards have already been drawn by other players.
If you are spending Dragon Crystals to convert to event vouchers, take advantage of concurrent top-up rebate events like Starlit Delights to maximize crystal returns.
Dragon Crown Homage can yield high Heliolite Dice returns relative to investment for spenders, frequently returning more dice value than the raw crystal cost spent on vouchers.
title: I Went ALL IN on Dragon Crown Homage for the Dark Lady Figurine… and Got SO Much More! | Dragonheir
